facts.title: challah french toast
ingredients: 2 cups (16 ounces or 455 grams) cottage cheese, whole or low-fat
1 teaspoon vanilla bean paste or vanilla extract
2 teaspoons vanilla bean paste or vanilla extract
1 large (1-lb) loaf of challah bread, cut into 1 to 1.5-inch thick slices
Butter for the pan, salted or unsalted
facts.author: Deb Perelman
